parsed.internal_thinking: Best immediate value is to keep expanding from 18 toward 19/30 because it opens a high-pip future node 20 and a buildable node 30. 12->11 also has a decent path, but it only reaches a weak buildable port node at 3 with low pips. With current hand W1/S2/B1 I still can't build a road anyway, so no legal build move beats ending turn unless a trade can fix that, but no strong trade opportunity is available from the visible state. End turn and hold resources for a stronger build next turn.
parsed.note_to_self: Claude remains the main threat; he is pushing stone control and development cards. Best road line from 18 is toward 19, with future node 20 high-value and node 30 buildable.
